subject.title: [Feature]: Structured Callback Actions and Thread Context Inheritance for Agent Handoffs

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-party structured `sessions_send`/handoff action contract now, or keep this as acceptance coverage for a broader A2A handoff design?
rationale: The remaining work changes agent tool/API semantics and message-delivery behavior, so repository policy treats it as a maintainer product/API decision rather than a safe cleanup close or autonomous fix lane.

options.title: Keep as handoff acceptance work
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the next A2A handoff implementation to cover structured skip/no-reply outcomes and channel/thread inheritance tests.

options.title: Implement a narrow action field
options.body: Add a minimal additive `sessions_send` action/routing override while preserving current sentinel-token behavior and defaults.

options.title: Fold into broader protocol work
options.body: Close only after a canonical handoff protocol issue or merged PR explicitly owns these exact acceptance cases.

recommendation.title: Keep as handoff acceptance work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the next A2A handoff implementation to cover structured skip/no-reply outcomes and channel/thread inheritance tests.
